10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple Clik Valve products listed with prices: RRP 49,99 € / 33,99 €; RRP 16,95 € / 11,99 €; RRP 5,95 € / 3,79 €; RRP 16,95 € / 9,99 €. Additional prices from ebike24.com: €11.95, €13.99 / €11.90
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from 11 distinct prices found across both sources. Prices included both RRP and sale prices for various Schwalbe Clik Valve products (valve kits with and without pump heads, valve adapters). Median calculated as €11.99 (6th value when sorted).

27.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve - Tubeless-Ventil - 2er Set - 60 mm - BIKE24
27.evidenceText: Three distinct Clik Valve product listings identified: (1) p1859949.html - 60mm 2er Set, (2) p1859948.html - 40mm 2er Set, (3) p1859950.html - 80mm 2er Set. Sources 4-5 are tubes with Clik Valve (accessories), not Clik Valve products.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs for Clik Valve products only. Excluded tube products (sources 4-5) as they are accessories bundled with Clik Valve, not the valve product itself. Three distinct Schwalbe Clik Valve valve sets in different sizes (40mm, 60mm, 80mm) were identified from sources 1-3.

30.evidenceText: The provided content excerpt only shows navigation menu items and does not include product availability/stock status information.
30.extractionRationale: The evidence provided does not contain any stock status indicators such as 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', 'ausverkauft', or similar terms. The content appears to be incomplete, showing only the website navigation structure.

36.evidenceText: The Schwalbe Clik Valve can also be inflated with conventional SV pumps. All you need is the pump head adapter, which can simply be plugged into your existing pump.
36.extractionRationale: Only one product page provided. While it mentions pump head adapters as related accessories, the evidence does not contain data about what fraction of Clik valve product pages display accessories in 'frequently bought together' or 'related products' sections. Cannot determine attach rate from single page sample.

37.evidenceText: Product information Features Size guide Specifications Spare parts Find a dealer
37.extractionRationale: The evidence references a "Spare parts" section in the product page navigation, but the actual detailed inventory of distinct replacement/spare part SKUs (valve cores, seals, o-rings, replacement kits) is not included in the provided content. The excerpt does not contain a specific count or enumeration of available spare parts.

45.sourceTitle: Best road bike wheels 2027 — transform your road bike with some shiny new hoops - Cycling News | Bike Reviews | road.cc
45.evidenceText: The article reviews multiple 2027 wheelsets from Hunt and Mavic (Hunt Superdura Dynamo Disc, Hunt 48 Limitless Aero Disc, Hunt Race Aero Wide, Mavic Ksyrium 30 Disc) but contains no mention of Clik valve adoption or valve specifications for any products.
45.extractionRationale: No evidence in the source directly states that any major wheelset brand (DT Swiss, Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) has adopted Clik valve as standard in 2026/2027 product lines. While the article discusses 2027 wheelsets from Hunt and Mavic, it does not mention valve types or Clik adoption. Therefore, 0% of major brands have confirmed Clik valve adoption based on available evidence.

50.evidenceText: Found 2 distinct Clik valve-specific pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - dedicated Clik Valve technical page with mounting and technical information, and (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - Bike Tire Valves FAQ page with detailed Clik Valve information. Other sources were either general pages or product pages that only mention Clik compatibility.
50.extractionRationale: Counted unique URLs that are specifically dedicated to Clik valve technical documentation, installation guides, or FAQ pages. Source 1 and Source 3 are dedicated Clik valve pages. Source 2 is a general FAQ that mentions Clik among other valve types. Source 4 is a general assembly videos page. Source 5 is an Aerothan Tube product page that only mentions Clik compatibility.

56.evidenceText: Numerous butyl tubes with CLIK VALVE are now available: The SCV butyl tubes No. 3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, and 19 are equipped with the Schwalbe Clik Valve as standard
56.extractionRationale: Source 3 explicitly lists all SCV butyl tube numbers equipped with Clik Valve as standard. Counting the distinct models: 3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19 = 10 distinct inner tube models. This is the authoritative source for Clik-equipped tubes.
